All routed referrals in the quarter (census) for routing correctness; 20-file sample tracing routed tier against the required-approvals list.
PASS = referral routed to the authority matching the highest required approval with a priority flag and deadline; FAIL = misroute, missing priority flag, or missing response-by date.
On FAIL, the referral is re-routed to the correct authority the same day and the misroute logged; deadline-at-risk cases are escalated to the Underwriting Manager.
The workflow routing table is driven by the Authority Matrix v3.2 delegation register mapping each tier to its authorised holders and backups.

answers.value: The response deadline set on a referral, aligned to the broker quote deadline and the internal referral SLA; population = referrals being submitted on the underwriter's book that need a response-by date.
Set at routing; the deadline is the earlier of the broker quote deadline (from the CRM/submission) minus a working-day buffer and the internal SLA of 2-3 business days.
The referral carries a response-by date, the source of the constraint (broker deadline vs. internal SLA), and a buffer for implementation. A referral without a response-by date cannot be routed.
The response-by date is no later than the broker quote deadline minus the implementation buffer; the set date reconciles to the broker deadline held in the CRM, with any exception noted.
Deadline and its basis recorded on the referral with timestamp; retained 7 years and used to measure SLA adherence.
Cases where the broker deadline is shorter than the internal SLA are exceptions escalated for expedited handling; disposition (expedite / seek extension from broker) recorded with same-day action.
Not model-driven; the deadline follows the approved referral-SLA procedure version and the buffer standard.
N/A - no numerical sensitivity; the buffer size flexes with case complexity (larger buffer for accounts needing actuarial review).
Any referral whose broker deadline leaves less than the standard buffer is treated as time-critical and expedited.
All referrals routed in the quarter (census) for whether a valid deadline was set; 15-file sample checking the deadline against the broker quote date.
PASS = response-by date set, at or before the broker deadline minus buffer, with the constraint source recorded; FAIL = missing deadline or a deadline later than the broker quote date.
On FAIL, the deadline is corrected before routing; where the broker window is too short, the case is expedited or a broker extension is sought the same day.
Acceptance = a response-by date set on the referral that protects the broker quote deadline and meets the internal SLA, with the constraint source recorded.
Recorded on the PolicyCenter referral; broker quote deadline sourced from the CRM submission record.
